resources.string: Optional: uses an accessibility service connection and an ongoing notification to help keep YiZhe running in the background. It does not read screen content, click, collect events or transmit data. The system may still stop it; fast startup is not guaranteed. You control this service in system Accessibility settings. Message and call services continue independently.
Find “YiZhe startup acceleration” under installed services or downloaded apps. Use its system switch to enable or disable it. Names vary by phone.
Tap to view status or open settings to turn it off.
